title: Wave Is All You Need: A Quantum Language Model Based on Fully Connected Quantum Boltzmann Machine
abstract: arXiv:2610.34492v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This work proposes a self-attention mechanism based on the fully connected quantum Boltzmann machine (FC-QBM), and further constructs a fully connected quantum Boltzmann machine language model (FC-QBM-LM) using the mechanism as the core engine. By performing unitary evolution on semantic quantum states, the mechanism implicitly implements positional encoding and self-attention computation, eliminating the need to decompose continuous semantic streams into discrete matrices for explicit matrix multiplication, with the measurement results naturally satisfying the normalization condition. Specifically, this work rigorously derives the computational principle of the self-attention mechanism based on FC-QBM, and demonstrates that this mechanism is mathematically equivalent to the classical self-attention mechanism. translated_title: 波即所需：基于全连接量子玻尔兹曼机的量子语言模型
translated_abstract: 本工作提出了一种基于全连接量子玻尔兹曼机（FC-QBM）的自注意力机制，并进一步以该机制为核心引擎构建了全连接量子玻尔兹曼机语言模型（FC-QBM-LM）。通过对语义量子态执行酉演化，该机制隐式地实现了位置编码与自注意力计算，从而无需将连续语义流分解为离散矩阵进行显式矩阵乘法，且测量结果自然满足归一化条件。具体而言，本工作严格推导了基于FC-QBM的自注意力机制的计算原理，并证明该机制在数学上与经典自注意力机制等价。本文还深入推导了FC-QBM-LM训练与生成过程所遵循的数学原理，以及两种相应的（算法与实现）。
tldr: 该论文提出基于全连接量子玻尔兹曼机的自注意力机制并据此构建量子语言模型，通过对语义量子态的酉演化隐式实现位置编码与自注意力计算，在数学上与经典自注意力机制等价，从而免除了显式矩阵乘法的需求。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a self-attention mechanism based on the fully connected quantum Boltzmann machine and constructs a quantum language model around it, which implicitly implements positional encoding and self-attention through unitary evolution of semantic quantum states, proving mathematical equivalence to the classical self-attention mechanism while eliminating explicit matrix multiplication.
